features.name: log_credit_amount
features.description: Natural-log transform of credit_amount using log1p to compress the right tail while preserving ordering.
features.expected_model_benefit: Lets tree splits isolate very small, medium, and very large requests with fewer cut points on a skewed scale.

features.name: monthly_credit_amount
features.description: Credit amount per month of contractual duration; a simple repayment-size proxy.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes nonlinear stress from combining size and term, enabling direct threshold splits.

features.name: duration_bucket_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal duration band: 0 for duration < 12, 1 for 12-23, 2 for 24-35, 3 for 36 or more months.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides coarse month bands that trees can split on without searching many nearby duration cut points.

features.name: credit_amount_bucket_ordinal
features.description: Ordinal credit_amount band: 0 for <1000, 1 for 1000-2999, 2 for 3000-6999, 3 for 7000 or more.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates interpretable request-size groups that are easy for trees to branch on.

features.name: long_large_credit_flag
features.description: Indicator for requests that are both long duration and large credit_amount.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights a high-exposure corner formed by size and repayment horizon.

features.name: max_installment_low_savings_flag
features.description: Indicator for maximum installment_commitment combined with the lowest savings_status category.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives trees a direct split for simultaneous high payment share and thin reserves.

features.name: overdrawn_checking_medium_credit_flag
features.description: Indicator for below-zero checking_status combined with at least a medium-sized credit_amount.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures a discrete liquidity-and-size combination that may not be found by single-column splits alone.

features.name: unstable_employment_high_installment_flag
features.description: Indicator for short or absent employment combined with elevated installment_commitment.
features.expected_model_benefit: Marks rows where income continuity and payment share jointly create a distinct profile.

features.name: account_liquidity_score
features.description: Semantic 0-5 ordinal assessment from checking_status and savings_status: 0 for below-zero checking with minimal savings, 1-2 for low or unknown reserves, 3-4 for moderate balances, 5 for strong readily available funds or no checking-account constraint.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two balance-related nominal fields into an ordered signal that tree splits can use directly.

features.name: credit_history_strength_score
features.description: Semantic 0-4 ordinal assessment of credit_history: 0 for delayed previously, 1 for no credits/all paid, 2 for all paid, 3 for existing paid, 4 for critical/other existing credit, reflecting strength of prior repayment record from the category text.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a monotone prior-record split instead of requiring many sparse category branches.

features.name: asset_backing_score
features.description: Semantic 0-5 ordinal assessment from property_magnitude and housing: 0 for no known property with rent or for free housing, 1-2 for car or rent combinations, 3-4 for life insurance or own housing, 5 for real estate plus own housing.
features.expected_model_benefit: Condenses asset and residence semantics into compact ordinal groups with intuitive cutoffs.

features.name: employment_capacity_score
features.description: Semantic 0-5 ordinal assessment from employment and job: 0 for unemployed or unemp/unskilled non res, 1-2 for <1 year or unskilled resident, 3-4 for 1-7 years or skilled, 5 for >=7 years with skilled or high qualif/self emp/mgmt work.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates an ordered proxy for income continuity and skill level that can be split at intuitive cutoffs.
